The '''Colonization Act''' was a law that was passed at some point during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. As a result of the Act and similar laws such as the [[Planet Grant Amendment]], many outlying [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] were colonized by settlers from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].
